edition.notes: A dated delivery state of the widely circulated English translation (also mirrored at EWTN and the New Advent library). The page names no translator and states no translation-specific rights; the translation's origin remains unidentified and its rights status unresolved, so consumers quote it only within ordinary scholarly limits with attribution. The Vatican web English page for the constitution was checked the same day and contained only a title shell without body text; the underlying Latin original of 1854 is public domain.

alternate_titles: Apostolic Constitution defining the dogma of the Immaculate Conception
work.author: Pope Pius IX
work.description: The apostolic constitution of 8 December 1854 by which Pius IX solemnly defined the Immaculate Conception of the Blessed Virgin Mary. The Latin original was published in Pii IX Pontificis Maximi Acta, part I, vol. 1; the definition sentence is Denzinger-Schoenmetzer 2803 (older numbering 1641). The constitution has no official numbered-paragraph locus system; editions record the section or sentence cited.
work.title: Ineffabilis Deus
